definitions: To openly display one's emotions or affections.
To make one's feelings apparent to others.
examples: She tends to wear her heart on her sleeve, so you always know how she's feeling.
He wears his heart on his sleeve, making him very transparent.
It's easy to read her; she wears her heart on her sleeve.
lemma: to wear one's heart on one's sleeve
synonyms: to lay one's cards on the table
source: to wear one's heart on one's sleeve
